description: Read immutable accepted form, popup or landing-page answers, payloads and field labels, newest first. Tracking starts when enabled; explicitly recovered rows include payload.recovery with inferred source attribution and event_time timestamp meaning. Requires subscribers:read plus widgets:read for forms/popups or landing_pages:read for landing pages. Use nextCursor to retrieve subsequent pages with the same filters. Responses include normalized submitted answers, not current profile values or double-opt-in confirmation.

companyId.description: Company override; otherwise uses selected company.

cursor.description: nextCursor returned by the preceding page.

field.description: Exact custom field name. Requires value.

format.description: Default json. csv returns a CSV string for this page; follow nextCursor to continue.

sourceId.description: Saved form, popup or landing page ID.

value.description: Exact scalar answer or array member. Requires field. Empty string is allowed.

name: list_capture_submissions

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `list_capture_submissions` MCP tool.

csv.description: CSV for this page, present only when format is csv.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null when complete.

source.description: The form, popup or landing page; id, name and type record returned by Sequenzy.

submissions.description: List of saved submission with id, companyId, sourceType, sourceId, nullable formId/popupId/landingPageId, subscriberId, createdAt, normalized payload and fieldLabels; optional payload.recovery marks reconstructed records with evidenceType, evidenceId, recoveredAt, sourceAttribution=inferred and timestampMeaning=event_time records returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
